open.text: a notice is in force and takes applications, or its next due date is still ahead

forecast.text: no open notice, and a forecast or an announced date for the next one

closed.text: the last deadline has passed and the funder's page shows the programme continuing

no-current-notice.text: This guide's label for a programme with no notice for the current cycle and no statement from the funder that it has ended. It reports an absence, not a closure.

formula.text: money allotted by formula or block grant, with no federal competition a non-profit can enter

not-competed.text: This guide's label for a programme whose funder has said that the competition is cancelled, paused or will not be held.

expired.text: the announcement lapsed, was archived or was ended early, and nothing replaces it

unconfirmed.text: the pages would not load or do not settle the question
